record.category: Ukrainian file host / online cinema (servers seized 2016)

free_tier.stated: Closed. 'Департамент киберполиции Национальной полиции Украины 15 ноября [2016] изъял сервера одного из крупнейших в Украине онлайн-кинотеатров fs.to. Ресурс прекратил работу по основному адресу.'

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the service is closed

retention.stated: not applicable: the servers were seized

record.interface_detail: None at the main address. A VK page claiming to be official announced a move to a new domain, according to the same report; no working replacement was verified.
record.chaining: Nothing to chain. Like EX.UA it explains why the Ukrainian market has no domestic large host and why the debrid Ukrainian record is a seedbox (seedbox-org-ua) rather than a host.

limits.value: servers seized 2016-11-15; service stopped at the main address

record.limits_note: The article names a claimed relocation ('Киберполиция изъяла сервера только на территории Украины') posted on a VK page; the claim is unverified and no live successor was found.
record.binding_note: Nothing is served; the closure is the fact.

identity_cost.detail: not applicable: no account can be created

record.reliability_note: The seizure of FS.TO is named in the same report as one of the pressures that preceded EX.UA's closure two days later.
record.confidence_note: The seizure date, the actor and the stopped service are quoted from RBC-Ukraine's report of 2016-11-17, read. The relocation claim is a quote of an unverified VK post and is labelled as such. Evidence dates normalised to the read date on 2026-10-23; a source that carries its own date keeps it in the proved field.

evidence.proved: the 2016-11-15 seizure of FS.TO's servers by Ukraine's cyberpolice, the service stopping at its main address, and the unverified VK relocation claim

record.notes: Recorded with FS.TO's sibling EX.UA so the pair is closed together. No live successor was found, and the VK relocation claim is not treated as one.
